notes.title: Dev Blog #3
notes.content:
Hey friends! ☕
It’s time for a fresh progress update from Vacation Cafe Simulator! Over May and June, we’ve been polishing systems, refining gameplay, and bringing more life to our cozy Italian world. Let’s take a look at what’s been cooking:


✅ What’s been done:


• Refined the cooking process based on internal playtests — making everything feel smoother and more fun.
• Reworked how players interact with the world — buying ingredients at the store, using kitchen surfaces, and more.
• Added a full tutorial and quest system to guide new players through the café experience.
• Continued work on sound design and original music to boost immersion.
• Improved customer NPC animations for more life-like movement.
• Started developing ambient NPCs to make the town feel more alive.
• Enhanced the main town area with more detail and new points of interest.
• Working on game balance to maintain both challenge and cozy vibes.
• Began implementing a save/load system so your café journey feels smooth and comfortable.
• Added a furniture and kitchen equipment store to help you upgrade your restaurant.
• Created tons of new artwork to deepen the warm 90s Italian atmosphere.
• Overall, we’re getting closer to a new test build and are polishing many aspects of the game.


🎯 What’s next:


We’ll keep refining everything for the best cozy and engaging experience possible. More playtesting, polish, and feature tweaks are on the way!

Thanks for following along — your support means the world to us!


Want to stay connected and share your thoughts?


🐦 Twitter/X: https://x.com/VacationCafeSim
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/5exQ8vaWsC


More cozy updates coming soon!✨

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
Hey friends! ☕
Time for another cozy progress update on Vacation Cafe Simulator. We've been hard at work improving core systems and adding fun new features — let’s take a look!

✅ What’s been done:

• Reworked (and continuing to improve) cooking mini-games for smoother, more intuitive gameplay.
• Added a recipe book – now all your recipes are in one place.
• Introduced a new main menu and loading screen.
• Completed a ton of technical work: improved state systems, building mode, and other core mechanics.
• Updated swimming mechanics and added oyster collecting.
• Began polishing new mechanics and improving the main location.

🔧 What’s next:

• Enhance how players interact with different surfaces in mini-games.
• Continue developing cooking-related mini-games.
• Rework scooter controls.
• Expand the storage system inside the restaurant.
• Redesign the product shopping process.
• Add a pause menu and graphics settings.
• Start implementing sound effects.
• Work on NPC animations (guests at the restaurant).
• Expand the world with new points of interest.

Thanks for following the journey — your support keeps us cooking!

There will be even more behind-the-scenes moments from development on our social media!

More updates coming soon! 🎉

notes.title: Welcome to Vacation Cafe Simulator!
notes.content:
Welcome to Vacation Cafe Simulator! ☕🏝️

Hello and welcome to the community! We're thrilled to finally share Vacation Cafe Simulator with you — a cozy, sunny restaurant management game where you build your dream cafe in a Mediterranean town, serve delicious food, and soak in the chill vibes of vacation life.

Whether you're a fan of food games, love interior decorating, or just want to enjoy a slice of cafe life in the sun, this game is for you.

🌟 What’s the game about?

In Vacation Cafe Simulator, you’ll:

• Manage your own cozy restaurant in a picturesque seaside town.
• Cook a variety of dishes including pizza, bruschetta, and croissants.
• Serve customers, customize your cafe's layout and decor, and make your spot the best in town!
• Decorate interiors, design your signboard, and create the atmosphere you love.
• Dive into co-op gameplay and enjoy the town with friends!

🛠️ Development so far...

Here’s a quick look at what we’ve been working on in the past few months:

✅ Added recipe system and new dishes (pizza, croissants, bruschetta)
✅ Implemented hint system to help players navigate easier
✅ Introduced a full build/decor mode for custom interiors
✅ Added furniture, signboard editor, and early character AI
✅ Multiple technical improvements for co-op and beyond
✅ Created several beautiful locations and began testing gameplay mechanics
✅ Focused heavily on polish, 3D content, and sound/music integration

🔧 What’s next?

Here’s what we’re cooking up for the next updates:

🍳 Improved food mini-games for deeper, more satisfying cooking
📦 Enhanced inventory and interaction with the environment
🧢 Character editor and item customization options
📖 Recipe book system
🎮 New mini-games, lots of small quality-of-life upgrades
🎵 Sound and music updates
🌍 Expansion of main and additional cafe locations

We're also continuing to test gameplay, identify weak spots, and refine the experience. Your feedback will be key as we move forward.

💬 Join us!

We’d love for you to follow our journey — wishlist the game and leave a comment. We’re building this game with the community in mind, so your thoughts, ideas, and support mean the world to us.

Thanks for being here — let’s build the ultimate vacation cafe together!
